items.message: Roth.isPrimitive_pow✝ {p : Polynomial ℤ} (hp : p.IsPrimitive) (t : ℕ) : (p ^ t).IsPrimitive

private theorem Roth.isPrimitive_pow : ∀ {p : Polynomial ℤ}, p.IsPrimitive → ∀ (t : ℕ), (p ^ t).IsPrimitive :=
fun {p} hp t ↦
  Nat.rec Polynomial.isPrimitive_one
    (fun t ih ↦ Eq.mpr (id (congrArg Polynomial.IsPrimitive (pow_succ p t))) (Polynomial.IsPrimitive.mul ih hp)) t
